text.p: Anicom Inc, which reported record second quarter results, said Monday it expects the second half of 1997 and all of 1998 to be strong.
"We foresee a strong second half for 1997 and an even more dynamic 1998," Scott Anixter, chief executive officer, said in a statement.

Earlier, Anicom, which makes Internet and communications connection products, reported a 77 percent rise in net income for the second quarter to a record $1.1 million. Earnings were $0.07 a primary share on 16.4 million shares outstanding, up from $0.05 on 12.9 million shares. Sales rose 83 percent to a record $52.5 million.

"Our focus over the next 18 months will be to maximize operating leverage and profitability from our acquisitions through gross and net margin improvement in our core component products," Carl Putnam, president, said in a statement. "We will continue to build a solid foundation of critical mass necessary to continue our integrated growth strategy through internal growth and the pursuit of selected acquisition opportunities as they develop."
